summary: Poole researches how AI agents can be attacked, wants AI infrastructure people own, and asks who funds the push to slow frontier AI.

statements.quote: I think there is a new attack surface in AI agents that people are not really looking at yet.
Prompt injection was only the beginning. The real AI security problem is authority.
But if society is being asked to slow one of the most consequential technologies ever built, we should know who funds that argument and how it reaches policymakers.
Most people won’t lose to AI. They’ll lose to people who learned how to use it before they did.
The cloud is convenient, but I want AI infrastructure I actually own.
